mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as central bank accommodation supports asset demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines below 0.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in labor force employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal robust economic expansion that elevates corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and INDPRO fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 35% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0), a decline in federal funds rate below 0.5% triggers positive equity returns as central bank accommodation reduces real interest rates and supports asset valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS declines below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in new housing starts (HOUST) above 1,150 thousand units indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1,150 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals imminent economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 440,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and RSAFS < 440,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic recovery accelerates.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 35% of instances.
